PyTorch Lightning Compromise (Mini Shai-Hulud)

Target: pytorch-lightning
Repository: https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning
Date: 2026-04-30
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: Python
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 0
Domain: pypi.org (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Mini Shai-Hulud campaign compromised the Lightning (PyTorch Lightning) package on PyPI. The attack utilized an obfuscated payload to exfiltrate GitHub tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, and .env files to zero.masscan.cloud.
